description: Mint a new squirrelscan API key for this organization and return it. The result contains a secret, a live credential for the organization, returned exactly once and never retrievable again; it is meant to be saved as the SQUIRRELSCAN_API_KEY environment variable for the CLI, CI, and MCP. Requires credentials carrying the keys:write scope, which OAuth sign-in grants to organization owners and admins. Minted keys cannot themselves mint keys.

expires_in_days.description: Expire the key after this many days (default: never expires).

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the dashboard, e.g. "ci" or "claude-code".

scopes.description: Scopes to grant (default: audits:write, audits:read, credits:read, org:read). Grantable: audits:write, audits:read, credits:read, org:read, org:write.

name: create_api_key
title: Create an API key
